messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Detected regression: canary cluster (hosted-api-us-west1) error rate spike to 14.8% over 5m. Autoscaler showed no CPU pressure. Rolling risk: high for realtime customers. Runbook: https://runbooks/internal/rollback-orchestration
Jess (Oncall): saw the alert, joining. any customer-facing errors?
Anya (PM): customers reporting degraded completions and timeouts on long prompts, some 504s. Not seeing data loss reports yet.
Marco (Platform): checking canary deploy metadata now — this was a staggered rollout, deploy-id=deploy_2026_03_15_08. Canary at 10% traffic.
Priya (SRE): quick glance at traces — tail latency correlates with model shard rebalancing after new image introduced. Errors = 500s from model runtime during checkpoint load.
Jess (Oncall): ok escalate to rollback. Is automated rollback enabled? Deploy Bot: ?
Deploy Bot: Automated rollback attempted at 2369801270 but aborted: precondition failed: "open-db-transactions" check not met. See logs: /logs/deploy_2026_03_15_08.txt
Priya (SRE): that abort is expected; we block auto-rollback if precommit locks are present to avoid partial state. We'll need manual intervention.
Marco (Platform): copy: preparing manual rollback plan. Steps: 1) pause routing to canary 2) flip feature flag (kill-switch) 3) promote previous stable image 4) smoke test 5) drain nodes & monitor.
Jess (Oncall): I'm on routing. Marco, can you generate exact rollback command?
Marco (Platform): runbook snippet:```\
# flip flag in flag service
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADM_TOKEN" \
  https://flags.redwood.internal/api/v1/flags/hosted-canary -d '{"value": "off"}'

# promote stable image
rbctl promote --from deploy_2026_02_28_22 --to production --confirm
```
Jess (Oncall): executing flag flip now. Will post status.
Jess (Oncall): @here flip response: 200 OK, feature flag hosted-canary=false :white_check_mark:
Marco (Platform): great. Starting promotion to previous stable image. Kick off in 1m.
Deploy Bot: Promotion job started at 2369801312, job-id=promote_9821. Tracking logs: /jobs/promote_9821/logs
Priya (SRE): confirm we have a rollback window longer than cache TTLs — sending note to cache team to avoid stale KV issues.
Anya (PM): ETA to full recovery? customers in region X on 10% of traffic — if rollback completes cleanly maybe 10-15m. Communicating to SOC and CS.
Marco (Platform): promotion progressing, 3/5 canary pods replaced successfully. Observability: error rate trending down but tail latency still elevated on replaced nodes.
Jess (Oncall): running smoke tests against sample tenant id=tenant-438. Command:```\
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TEST_TOKEN" https://hosted-api-us-west1/v1/generate -d '{"prompt": "hi"}'
```
Jess (Oncall): smoke: 200 and response payload looks normal on first replaced pod. :thumbsup:
Priya (SRE): note — we should still drain the old nodes to avoid in-flight kv cache inconsistency. Running drain script now:```\
./node-drain --node node-xy-12 --grace 60
```
Marco (Platform): promote job completed at 2369801368, all canary instances now running stable image. Traffic routing switched back to baseline.
Deploy Bot: Promotion job status = SUCCESS.
Incident Bot: auto-monitoring: error rate dropped to 1.1% within 3m of promote. Latency p95 back to normal.
Jess (Oncall): verifying end-to-end with longer prompt (10k tokens simulation) — running load test now.
Priya (SRE): while load test runs, checking backend logs for any smoldering 5xx. Nothing new in the last 2m.
Anya (PM): starting customer comms: sending update to CS bucket and the status page draft. Impact classified as partial degradation for hosted-api-us-west1, 08:10-08:25 UTC window.
Marco (Platform): one caveat — during manual promote we observed stale KV reads from the prefix cache on 2 nodes; we've invalidated local caches and put a short TTL. Monitoring for consistency issues.
Jess (Oncall): load test passed for 5/5 synthetic sessions. Real traffic metrics show reduction in errors. I'm marking the incident as mitigated but leaving monitoring for 30m.
Priya (SRE): followups: 1) investigate why automated rollback precondition blocked promotion — maybe tighten detection or allow safe rollback with db lock awareness 2) add a checkpoint to ensure model warmup completed before traffic shift 3) improve runbook to include cache invalidation step.
Anya (PM): action items logged in incident ticket INC-2026-0315-42. I'll coordinate postmortem and customer notes.
Marco (Platform): thumbs: I'll open a PR to update the rollout controller to better signal model readiness before scaling.
Deploy Bot: closing promotion job logs: /jobs/promote_9821/logs (archived)
Jess (Oncall): final check: are we good to close pager? reactions?
Priya (SRE): +1 - keep eyes on dashboards for 30m then close.
Anya (PM): will publish an incident summary in 2 hours after root cause triage.
Incident Bot: Incident marked mitigated at 2369801430 by Jess (Oncall).
Jess (Oncall): closing thread for now, will re-open if metrics deviate. Thanks team. :v:
